name: fight15-s03
title: Unready Start counts down from thirty seconds and cancels

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
text_watch start countdown-before-state equals substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus Waiting for Joiner to press Ready
text_watch start countdown-before-layout layout substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-before-duplicates duplicates substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-before-persistent shown substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus
video_mark countdown-before-host
wait_ms 4000
text_watch assert countdown-before-state
text_watch assert countdown-before-layout
text_watch assert countdown-before-duplicates
text_watch assert countdown-before-persistent
activate ButtonMultiplayerStart
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in 30 s
video_mark countdown-30-host
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerStart Cancel Start
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in 30 s - waiting for Joiner to press Ready
assert_text_fits LabelMultiplayerStatus
text_watch start countdown-active-host-state contains substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in
text_watch start countdown-active-host-layout layout substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-active-host-duplicates duplicates substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-active-host-persistent shown substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in 28 s
video_mark countdown-28-host
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in 28 s - waiting for Joiner to press Ready
wait_ms 1200
text_watch assert countdown-active-host-state
text_watch assert countdown-active-host-layout
text_watch assert countdown-active-host-duplicates
text_watch assert countdown-active-host-persistent
activate ButtonMultiplayerStart
wait_ms 1200
text_watch start countdown-cancel-state equals substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus Waiting for Joiner to press Ready
text_watch start countdown-cancel-layout layout substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-cancel-duplicates duplicates substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-cancel-persistent shown substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus
video_mark countdown-cancel-host
wait_ms 3000
text_watch assert countdown-cancel-state
text_watch assert countdown-cancel-layout
text_watch assert countdown-cancel-duplicates
text_watch assert countdown-cancel-persistent
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 120
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
video_mark countdown-before-joiner
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Press Ready when you're ready to play
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is starting the match in 30 s
video_mark countdown-30-joiner
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is starting the match in 30 s - press Ready
assert_text_fits LabelMultiplayerStatus
text_watch start countdown-active-joiner-state contains substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is starting the match in
text_watch start countdown-active-joiner-layout layout substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-active-joiner-duplicates duplicates substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-active-joiner-persistent shown substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is starting the match in 28 s
video_mark countdown-28-joiner
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is starting the match in 28 s - press Ready
text_watch assert countdown-active-joiner-state
text_watch assert countdown-active-joiner-layout
text_watch assert countdown-active-joiner-duplicates
text_watch assert countdown-active-joiner-persistent
wait_ms 1200
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Press Ready when you're ready to play
text_watch start countdown-joiner-cancel-state equals substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus Press Ready when you're ready to play
text_watch start countdown-joiner-cancel-layout layout substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-joiner-cancel-duplicates duplicates substate:Lobby
text_watch start countdown-joiner-cancel-persistent shown substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus
video_mark countdown-cancel-joiner
wait_ms 2500
text_watch assert countdown-joiner-cancel-state
text_watch assert countdown-joiner-cancel-layout
text_watch assert countdown-joiner-cancel-duplicates
text_watch assert countdown-joiner-cancel-persistent
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 120
wait_ms 1400
exit
